content.comment_body: Hello, I'm facing a connection issue between my PC and a [product_name] device. When I connect the PC directly to the device, I can't communicate with it. My PC's IP configuration is: IP 192.168.0.230, mask 255.255.255.0, gateway 192.168.0.1. The device's IP address is 192.168.0.3, mask 255.255.255.0, gateway 192.168.0.1. The device is a [product_name] with [version_no], and I'm using [product_name] software version [version_no]. Strangely, the software detects the device, but further communication fails. I've tried with another computer and got the same result. Please let me know if you need more details.
Hi, could you provide the article number of your [product_name] device? Also, can you share the program you created?

Hello, thank you for your reply. I'm new to this area, and I'm not sure what you mean by 'article number' of my [product_name]. The diagram I made is quite simple, with the I1 input directly connected to the Q1 output. I've attached screenshots of the diagram.
The second attachment shows the network project, as you can see the software is able to detect my [product_name] device.
The last attachment displays the error message I received.

There could be several causes: 1. The network cable may be faulty. 2. If connecting the PC directly without a router, ensure your PC isn't connected to any other network that shares the gateway 192.168.0.1. 3. If using a router, check that no other device uses the same IP address as your [product_name] (192.168.0.3). 4. Use the PING command from your PC to the device (ping 192.168.0.3). 5. Try PING again, but disconnect the device—if you still get a response, there might be another device using the same IP. 6. Use ipconfig (Windows) or ifconfig (Linux) to ensure your PC is only on one network and the gateways differ for each network. I hope these suggestions help, as I don't have more information.

Hello, I've discovered the problem—I was using the wrong software version. Changing from [version_no] to [version_no] allowed my PC to connect to the device successfully. Everything is working now, thank you!

analysis.insight_summary: The main issue encountered involved connectivity problems between a PC and a [product_name] device. Although the software recognized the device, further communication failed due to a mismatch in software versions. Compatibility between device firmware and software version proved essential for successful connection and operation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect smooth and reliable communication and connectivity between their PC and the [product_name] device whenever the software detects the device, regardless of version mismatches.
